nodes.name: PROJECT_BRIEF.md
nodes.summary: Shared brief for the AI Assistant Pro redesign: verified stack and serving facts, the DOM and API contracts the UI must keep, exclusive file ownership, and the view/controller seam every subagent follows.

nodes.name: audit.md
nodes.summary: Read-only Phase 1 audit of the vanilla frontend and FastAPI RAG backend, covering the DOM contract, persistence, SSE endpoints, feature gaps, security risks, and a staged implementation plan.

nodes.name: design-spec.md
nodes.summary: Phase 1 design specification for the chat shell: color and type tokens, theme and responsive layout, component states and ARIA, screen specs, the AI visualization, and the icon plan implementers must follow.

nodes.name: integration-notes.md
nodes.summary: Controller-layer notes mapping each UI action in app.js and api.js to its endpoint and view calls, plus backend gaps, QA follow-ups, and the reference-fidelity deviations that were left in place.

nodes.name: integration-test-plan.md
nodes.summary: Unexecuted plan for testing the real backend in an isolated loopback environment, with a scripted fake LLM and a matrix covering streaming, cancellation, uploads, SSRF, sessions, and the authorization gap.

nodes.name: qa-report-04.md
nodes.summary: Stage 4 QA report that passes the controller and view seam with issues: welcome cards never send, streaming and focus behave, and axe finds no violations, while a toast can cover Stop.

nodes.name: qa-report-05.md
nodes.summary: Reference-design QA report that passes the restyled shell with issues, closing the toast overlap and flagging an unverifiable privacy claim, weak outline contrast, and a misleading Upload Files card.

nodes.name: qa-report-06.md
nodes.summary: Re-verification report that closes every QA-05 finding, confirms the safer upload copy and file-chooser card, and re-runs the accessibility and regression suite with a clean pass.

nodes.name: security-issue-authz.md
nodes.summary: Recorded, unfixed finding that session read, rename, delete, and message feedback do not check ownership, so a guessed session id is enough because user_id is client-supplied and not authentication.

nodes.name: stage4-backlog.md
nodes.summary: Stage 4 controller backlog requiring welcome cards to switch mode and fill the composer without sending, plus carried QA items for focus, confirm dialogs, rename, model retry, and upload types.

nodes.name: ui-ux-implementation-notes.md
nodes.summary: Implementation record of the workspace dropdown, workspaces, and Settings screen, stating where the written brief overrides the presentation board and which controls were omitted because the backend cannot back them.

nodes.name: view-contract.md
nodes.summary: View/controller contract listing preserved DOM ids, exported view functions, callbacks, theme storage, and the stage-by-stage markup and script-order changes through the reference-design pass.
